text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Kenderaan

Motor (Pengecualian) 2021.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini berkuat kuasa bagi tempoh mulai 1 Februari 2021

hingga 31 Mac 2021.

Pengecualian

2. Menteri mengecualikan orang yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual daripada

pemakaian peruntukan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) tertakluk kepada syarat

bahawa orang yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual hendaklah memohon untuk

memperbaharui lesen kenderaan motornya atau lesen memandunya, mengikut

mana-mana yang berkenaan, dalam masa tiga puluh hari selepas Kaedah-Kaedah ini

terhenti berkuat kuasa.

Ketidakpakaian

3. Kaedah 2 tidaklah terpakai berkenaan dengan—

(a) mana-mana pemegang suatu lesen kenderaan motor bagi mana-mana

kenderaan barangan, kenderaan perkhidmatan awam, kenderaan

pelancongan atau kenderaan pekerja; dan

(b) mana-mana pemegang suatu lesen vokasional.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

MOTOR VEHICLES (EXEMPTION) RULES 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 66(1)(x) and 127(1)(b) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Motor Vehicles (Exemption) Rules 2021.

 (2) These Rules have effect for the period from 1 February 2021

to 31 March 2021.

Exemption

2. The Minister exempts persons specified in column (1) of the Schedule from the

application of the provisions specified in column (2) subject to the condition that the

persons specified in column (1) of the Schedule shall apply to renew his motor vehicle

licence or driving licence, as the case may be, within thirty days upon these Rules ceasing

to have effect.

Non-application

3. Rule 2 shall not apply in respect of—

(a) any holder of a motor vehicle licence for any goods vehicle, public service

vehicle, tourism vehicle or employees vehicle; and

(b) any holder of a vocational licence.
